data_ready.title: Data Ready
data_ready.description: True once the manifest lists a season and the players file

data_through.title: Data Through
data_through.description: How current the data is, e.g. "2026 week 9"

built_at.title: Built At
built_at.description: When the shards were built (ISO 8601, UTC): what the stale banner ages

IntentRequest.title: IntentRequest
IntentRequest.description: The frontend owns the stat and filter catalog, so it sends the allowed ids with each ask.

MarketSummary.title: MarketSummary
MarketSummary.description: Market value each side gives and gets (FantasyCalc), the hint and the values' date.

PlayerProfile.title: PlayerProfile
PlayerProfile.description: Display only: next game range, rest of season over replacement, injury, outlook.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.description: The question asks who leads or ranks first; the client orders the rows

SlotCall.title: SlotCall
SlotCall.description: Display only: how often this slot's starter outscores the best eligible bench player.

UnsupportedOutcome.title: UnsupportedOutcome
UnsupportedOutcome.description: No stat or filter can answer the question; `reason` is shown to the user.
